text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, when visiting the library to return some reference materials I've borrowed…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Have you some business to attend to here as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I've come to peruse some history books. Few people know this, but this library actually houses an extensive collection on history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I often come here in my free time to make use of it.
choice_data_list: Right, I remember that you're into history books.
Right, I remember that you're into history books.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. …They're absolutely captivating.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Within these pages lie the endeavors of those of the past, remaining forever for us in the present to pore over. That fact alone makes me tingle with excitement…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: By peering into the lives of the people who lived before us and contemplating how the historians who recorded them must have felt, I feel a surge of emotion from my own world expanding.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Every time I immerse myself in one of these books, I feel myself hoping to live my own life with such sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I feel that I gain something akin to… a courage needed to fulfill the moments I have.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Detecting a hint of excitement in Mejiro Ardan's voice, I find myself wanting to experience the sensation she's describing…
choice_data_list: I'm thinking of reading a history book myself.
I'm thinking of reading a history book myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh my! You truly want to?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well, um, in that case, if it's all right with you…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Please allow me to assist you with your search for a book to read.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Not at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So then, have you ever wanted to read a particular sort of history book? I'd like to make as informed a recommendation as I possibly can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knowing Mejiro Ardan, I've got no doubt that she knows the genre in and out. I should see what she recommends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'd like to read a history book that is…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Full of tumultuous events… Then perhaps one that recounts the rise and fall of an empire would be to your liking?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As people are faced with the potential collapse of their very civilization, their myriad decisions make waves upon history and result in a great deal of tumult.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I have a fair few good reads in mind. Shall we take a look at them?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before long, Mejiro Ardan gives me her handpicked recommendation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her words echo through my mind as I read through the history book she chose, and I get a glimpse into the sorts of things she holds dear…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Approachable for beginners… Then perhaps one that focuses on a specific historical figure would be to your liking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Historical events of their lifetime are relayed from their perspective, much in the same way that a novel's story is told through the eyes of its characters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I have a fair few good reads in mind. Shall we take a look at them?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before long, Mejiro Ardan gives me her handpicked recommendation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her words echo through my mind as I read through the history book she chose, and I get a glimpse into the sorts of things she holds dear…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: A book that I like! Well, I'd be perfectly happy to recommend one of those, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I wonder what I should do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This is highly embarrassing, but um… I simply have so many favorites that I can't narrow the selection down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I haven't had many opportunities like this to recommend history books either…
choice_data_list: Why don't you tell me what you like about all your favorite books?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Understood. Then I shall do precisely that—in great detail, and to the best of my ability!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, as I watch Mejiro Ardan's history book presentation unfold…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I get a glimpse into the sorts of things she holds dear from the way she talks so excitedly about her favorite history books…
